messages:
Ryan: Heads-up — NordicApps submitted an escalation: their March invoice is ~18% higher than the numbers shown in our usage dashboard. Support opened a ticket. Can eng look into possible ingestion/replay gaps?
Jen: Filing details from customer: invoice PDF + dashboard screenshots. They say spikes around 2026-03-12 02:00–06:00 UTC. Ticket #SUP-2147.
SupportLead: Customer-facing note: told them we're investigating and will share ETA in 2 hours.
Carmen: I pulled the eventstore/ingest metrics — we had a brief write-queue stall on 2026-03-12 02:18–02:45 UTC due to a mounted volume hiccup on primary region. Replication caught up but we did see ~110k events delayed.
Marta: Do we know if delayed events were dropped or marked for replay?
Carmen: The ingestion pipeline normally writes to kafka -> dedupe -> metering. The dedupe window was extended during the stall. Backfill job for delayed window was enqueued automatically but the replay-run failed with checksum mismatch.
BillingOpsBot: Automated alert: meter-backfill-job-987 failed (exit 1) at 2026-03-12T03:12:21Z. Error: checksum_mismatch. Logs: /var/logs/meter/backfill-987.log
Ryan: checksum_mismatch is worrying — could cause double-counts if partial replays succeeded. Carmen, can you paste the relevant tail from the backfill log?
Carmen: pasted tail:
```
2026-03-12T03:11:59Z INFO replay: starting window 2026-03-12T02:00Z -> 2026-03-12T06:00Z tenant=nordicapps
2026-03-12T03:12:10Z ERROR replay: checksum_mismatch expected=af23.. got=af24.. event_id=evt_8xY
2026-03-12T03:12:12Z INFO replay: retrying chunk 42/100
2026-03-12T03:12:18Z ERROR replay: duplicate_event_id detected id=evt_8xY
2026-03-12T03:12:21Z FATAL replay: aborting due to inconsistent state
```
Jen: Customer is worried about being overbilled while dashboard shows lower usage. Any quick mitigation?
Carmen: Immediate mitigation: pause invoice generation/adjust ledger tagging for the affected billing cycle until we reconcile. Billing team needs a freeze flag.
Marta: I'll open a hold for NordicApps on the billing pipeline and notify finance.
EngOncall: Trying a dry-run of the replay to surface diffs without applying ledger writes:
```
replay-tool run --tenant nordicapps --from 2026-03-12T02:00Z --to 2026-03-12T06:00Z --dry-run --output=diff.json
```
EngOncall: Dry-run produced ~+1.17M tokens compared to dashboard counts; interestingly tokenization differs by ~7% vs what invoices use.
Ryan: Wait — tokenization difference? Did we change tokenizer version in the dashboard aggregation? That could explain mismatch in token counts vs ledger which uses the raw event token_count field.
Carmen: Confirmed: on 2026-03-01 we rolled out tokenizer v2 for the realtime dashboard aggregator (to improve partial counts). Ledger ingestion still uses token_count from the original event payload (v1). During replay the replay-tool re-tokenizes events (uses current tokenizer by default) which explains checksum and counts differences.
Jen: So root causes: (1) eventstore stall delayed events, (2) replay failed with checksum/dup detection, (3) tokenizer version drift leads to re-tokenization diffs and apparent token count variance.
SupportLead: Customer update template: "We're seeing a difference between dashboard views and invoice totals due to an internal reconciliation job; no customer-facing overcharge will be applied while we investigate." ok to send?
Ryan: Yes, but add ETA: 24 hours for initial reconciliation and 72 hours for final correction. Assign owners.
Marta: Owners: Carmen (replay and dedupe fix), EngOncall (replay dry-run and stable replay config), BillingOps (freeze invoice + manual audit).
Carmen: Plan: 1) fix replay-tool to use ledger-tokenization mode (replay-tool --use-original-token-count) to avoid re-tokenizing, 2) re-run replay with de-dup mode and checksum verification enabled, 3) reconcile ledger diffs vs dashboard and produce audit CSV for finance.
EngOncall: Patch ready, testing now. Example flag we added:
```
# force replay to use original token_count field instead of re-tokenizing
replay-tool run --tenant nordicapps --from 2026-03-12T02:00Z --to 2026-03-12T06:00Z --use-original-token-count --dedupe-ids --apply-safely
```
Carmen: Ran small window test (02:10–02:20) with flags — diff matches ledger exactly, no checksum mismatch.
BillingOpsBot: Request: generate provisional credit memo draft for NordicApps showing potential overcharge delta (-$2,400) pending final audit.
Marta: Draft created and sent to financeOps for approval.
Ryan: Customer note: I'll send a status update in 1h. Please ping here when the full-window dry-run completes.
Jen: Customer replied: thanks, appreciate the quick response.
Carmen: Full-window dry-run completed at 2026-03-12T05:58Z — produced candidate changes: +1,030,452 tokens attributable to replayed events, ledger delta matches dashboard when using --use-original-token-count. No checksum mismatch after the flag.
EngOncall: Starting safe apply now with --apply-safely. Estimated apply time ~45m.
SupportLead: Noted. I'll update the customer after apply completes and once finance approves the provisional credit.
Ryan: Postmortem TODOs: document tokenizer versioning impact, add a replay integrity test to CI, add better backfill observability (chunk-level checksums), and add a billing freeze flow. Assign owners in the ticket.
Marta: Added postmortem checklist to incident ticket.
Jen: Customer updated: we placed an invoice hold and will follow up with any credits. They appreciated the transparency. :thumbsup:
Ryan: Thanks all. Closing loop when finance confirms credits.
BillingOpsBot: Archived ticket SUP-2147 -> incident-1864009876 by BillingOpsBot
